end.line: Quillon for Larchfield Insurance’s claims legal team

vo: Larchfield Insurance’s claims legal team reviews about five thousand policy wordings a year, and exclusions are phrased differently across products.
Ask whether a flood exclusion applies to a product, and the answer comes back cited to the exact clause.
When a broker emails a coverage question, Quillon drafts the reply in Outlook, citing the policy wording.
Your coverage positions are remembered in the playbook, and a senior lawyer approves each one.
Owen will walk your team through it on Friday the twenty-seventh.
